```plato

    //==
    // # Building a cloth — from a grid
    //
    // The constraint graph of a flat patch, derived from `ClothGrid3D` with no
    // mesh in between. Three families of spring, all with rest lengths read off
    // the grid's own initial geometry:
    //
    //  - STRUCTURAL, between neighbours along each axis: resists stretching.
    //  - SHEAR, along both diagonals of each cell: resists the grid collapsing
    //    into a parallelogram, which structural springs alone allow.
    //  - BEND, between vertices two apart along each axis: resists folding.
    //    On a grid this is the two-away spring rather than a dihedral
    //    constraint, because the pattern is regular enough for it and it costs
    //    one distance projection instead of four gradients. `ClothFromMesh`
    //    below produces the dihedral form.

    // The index of grid vertex (column, row) in the row-major vertex array.
    GridVertexIndex(self: ClothGrid3D, column: Integer, row: Integer): VertexIndex
        => VertexIndex(row * self.ColumnCount + column);
```
